profile.headline: Software Engineer | Active Clearance | Security+ & A+ | BS |  C# | .NET | SQL | ReactJs | NodeJs  | Veteran
profile.summary: As a full-stack software engineer with expertise in ReactJS, NodeJS, ExpressJS, MongoDB, C#, .NET, and SQL, I have a strong foundation in both front-end and back-end development. In addition to my technical skills, I hold a CompTIA A+ certification and a BS in Networks & Cybersecurity. With my diverse skill set and experience, I am well-equipped to tackle any software development challenge. As a veteran, I also bring leadership, teamwork, and problem-solving skills to the table. I am excited to continue learning and growing in my career as a software engineer. Additionally, I have a secret security clearance, which allows me to work on sensitive projects that require a high level of trust and discretion.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a full-stack web application for FEMA using Angular, Kendo UI, and Java Spring Boot, enabling US homeowners to obtain flood insurance quotes through a government website.

• Developed a DataDog dashboard to monitor API performance and downstream dependencies.

• Leveraged CI/CD pipelines using Harness, improving deployment efficiency and reducing time-to-market for new features.

• Performed Agile methodologies to manage project timelines and deliverables, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

• Leveraged Checkmarx for automated security scanning, enhancing the overall security posture of the application.

• Utilized a robust PostgreSQL database schema to efficiently store and retrieve flood insurance data from external API’s.

• Served as a consultant, providing expert insights and presentations that contributed to the company’s successful pursuit of government contracts by aligning technical solutions with federal requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed full-stack FEMA web applications using Angular, Kendo UI, and Java Spring Boot for flood insurance quoting.

Monitored API performance and downstream dependencies via custom DataDog dashboards to ensure high availability.

Leveraged CI/CD pipelines using Harness and automated security scanning via Checkmarx to enhance software posture.

Utilized PostgreSQL to efficiently manage and retrieve complex flood insurance data from external federal APIs.

Consulted on technical solutions to align with federal requirements, aiding in government contract pursuits and technical bids.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Migrated legacy applications to AWS GovCloud using serverless technologies including Lambda, API Gateway, and S3.

Designed a robust API integration framework to enhance inter-application communication and reduce data latency.

Conducted security audits and implemented measures to ensure compliance with federal data protection standards.

Managed multiple high-priority projects simultaneously, consistently delivering cloud-native solutions ahead of schedule.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developing and implementing AWS-based solutions. 

Development of requirements documentation, including functional and technical specifications.

Building and developing proof of concepts to validate solution designs.

Maintaining strong relationships with stakeholders to ensure successful project outcomes.

Working collaboratively with a team of engineers using Agile methodology to ensure project deliverables are met on time and to a high standard.

Designing, developing, and maintaining front-end applications from the ground.

Developing and implementing scalable solutions that can handle large volumes of traffic and data.

Conducting thorough testing of applications to ensure quality and scalability.

Staying up-to-date with emerging technologies and best practices in software engineering to ensure our solutions are cutting-edge and competitive.

Participating in code reviews and providing constructive feedback to team members to improve code quality.

Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including product management and design, to ensure solutions meet customer needs and expectations.

Providing technical guidance and support to team members.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Reverse-engineered legacy on-premises applications, preserving their existing UI/UX, and successfully migrated them to AWS GovCloud, leveraging serverless technologies like Lambda, API Gateway, and S3 to reduce operational costs and enhance scalability.

• Designed and implemented a robust API integration framework, enhancing inter-application communication and reducing data transfer latency.

• Conducted comprehensive security audits and implemented advanced security measures, reducing potential vulnerabilities and ensuring compliance with federal data protection standards.

• Successfully managed multiple high-priority projects simultaneously, consistently delivering ahead of schedule and exceeding client expectations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
✻ Collaborated with a team of software engineers to create full-stack web applications using: 
Javascript, React, Node, Express, MongoDB, HTML, and CSS
✻ Design responsive web applications consisting of RESTful APIs serving data to a JavaScript front-end and implement dynamic elements to improve user experience.
✻ Reviewed code and utilized unit testing, pair programming, and agile methodologies like SCRUM to guarantee quality code while meeting tight deadlines.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and deployed scalable, fault-tolerant applications on Microsoft Azure, utilizing services such as Azure Functions, App Service, and Cosmos DB, improving application performance and reliability.

• Implemented continuous integration and deployment pipelines, reducing deployment time and improving code quality through automated testing.

• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design and implement innovative solutions for complex business problems, contributing to increased overall team productivity.

• Engineered RESTful APIs and microservices architecture, improving system modularity and reducing API response times.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Microsoft Software & Systems Academy
positions.description:
✻ Mastered the fundamental knowledge of C#, dot NET, Azure, and SQL databases 
✻ Built local, server-based, and cloud-stored applications 
✻ Collaborated with a team of developers to build modern and responsive web applications using best practices. 
✻ Built semantically structured full-stack web applications 
✻ Applied Agile methodologies such as SCRUM for project management. 

Experience:
✻ Azure development
✻ Software development with C#
✻ Web development experience with HTML5/CSS/JavaScript
✻ Transact-SQL/Data for Access, integration, and manipulation
✻ Designing and building applications using ASP.NET framework
✻ Unit and integration testing to validate solutions with ASP.NET projects
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft SQL Server · C# · .NET Framework

positions.title: Marine Enlisted Commissioning Education Program
positions.description:
Competitively selected to transition from Enlisted (E-6, SSgt) to Officer (0-1, 2nd Lt.)

Completed all requirements of the Naval ROTC Program at The University of Washington - Seattle 

Serve as a Senior leader to the Midshipmen assigned to the NROTC with particular
emphasis on leadership, academics, physical fitness, and ethical decision-making.

Attended a 10-week course at Officer Candidates School (OCS) - Quantico, Virginia.

The primary goal of the Marine Enlisted Commissioning Education Program (MECEP) is the professional development of each student into a future Platoon Commander capable of leading Marines into combat.

Attitude, perception, and professional values were honed through the unit's training,
education, and leadership opportunities. Drawing upon a wealth of fleet experience, I contributed to the professional development of Midshipmen peers through engaged mentorship.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Supervisor - Staff Sergeant
positions.description:
Inspected, troubleshot, approved, and denied maintenance tasks performed by other
employees.
 
Trained, mentored, and led junior employees.
 
Enforced naval maintenance procedures and verified that all requirements were fulfilled.
 
Audited maintenance logs and records and inspected flight essential components to ensure they were
safe and flight ready.

positions.title: Lead
positions.description:
Leader & Staff NCO: Managed a shop of 30+ Marines, overseeing all airframe maintenance operations and development.

CDQAR: Served as the final technical authority, ensuring maintenance met rigorous safety and mission-readiness standards.

Lead Maintainer: Directed mission-critical maintenance and resource allocation during multiple global deployments.

Operational Management: Orchestrated complex logistics and maintenance schedules to ensure mission capability.

positions.title: Airframe and Powerplant Mechanic
positions.description:
Remove and replace flight critical components.
Inspect and sign work orders, ensuring safety and proper procedures have been followed.
Inspect immediate and surrounding areas for debris that may hinder flight operations.
